description_en: Retrieves the running status of real-time synchronization tasks and synchronization solution tasks
description_zh: 获取实时同步任务和同步解决方案任务的运行状态
name: GetDISyncInstanceInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for the current API invoke operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Data Integration synchronization task associated with the destination data source. Valid values:

DI_REALTIME: real-time Data Integration synchronization node.
DI_SOLUTION: Data Integration synchronization solution
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所关联的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。取值如下：

DI_REALTIME：表示数据集成实时同步任务。
DI_SOLUTION：表示数据集成同步解决方案
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
If TaskType is set to DI_REALTIME, FileId is the file ID of the real-time synchronization task.
If TaskType is set to DI_SOLUTION, FileId is the task ID of the synchronization solution.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh:
当TaskType为DI_REALTIME时，则FileId为实时同步任务的文件ID。
当TaskType为DI_SOLUTION时，则FileId为同步解决方案的任务ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

schema.description_en: The data structure returned for the Data Integration synchronization task
schema.description_zh: 数据集成同步任务返回的数据结构

Data.description_en: The running status of the synchronization task
Data.description_zh: 获取同步任务的运行状态

Message.description_en: The description of the failure cause when retrieving the running status of the synchronization task. If the running status of the Data Integration synchronization task is successfully retrieved, this parameter is empty
Message.description_zh: 获取同步任务运行状态失败后的原因描述。如果获取数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Name.description_en:
If TaskType is set to DI_REALTIME, Name is the name of the real-time synchronization task.
If TaskType is set to DI_SOLUTION, Name is empty
Name.description_zh:
如果taskType为DI_REALTIME，则name为实时同步任务的名称。
如果taskType为DI_SOLUTION， 则name为空

SolutionInfo.description_en:
If TaskType is set to DI_REALTIME, SolutionInfo is empty.
If TaskType is set to DI_SOLUTION, SolutionInfo contains the execution details of the synchronization solution
SolutionInfo.description_zh:
如果taskType为DI_REALTIME，则SolutionInfo为空。
如果taskType为DI_SOLUTION， 则SolutionInfo为同步解决方案运行详情

CreatorName.description_en: The name of the creator of the synchronization solution task
CreatorName.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务创建者名称

Id.description_en: The task ID of the synchronization solution

Status.description_en: The running status of the synchronization solution
Status.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行状态

StepDetail.description_en: The details of the execution steps for the synchronization solution task
StepDetail.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务运行步骤详情

items.description_en: The data structure returned for the Data Integration synchronization task
items.description_zh: 数据集成同步任务返回的数据结构

Info.description_en: The running information of the synchronization solution
Info.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行信息

Status.description_en: The status of the execution step for the synchronization solution
Status.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行步骤的状态

StepId.description_en: The ID of the execution step for the synchronization solution
StepId.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行步骤的ID

StepName.description_en: The name of the execution step for the synchronization solution
StepName.description_zh: 同步解决方案运行步骤的名称

Status.description_en:
If TaskType is set to DI_REALTIME, Status indicates the running status of the real-time task. Valid values: PAUSE, NORUN, RUN, KILLING, and WAIT. 

If TaskType is set to DI_SOLUTION, Status indicates the running status of the synchronization solution. Valid values: success and fail
Status.description_zh:
如果taskType为DI_REALTIME，则status为实时任务的运行状态。包括：PAUSE、NORUN、RUN、KILLING、WAIT。 

如果taskType为DI_SOLUTION， 则status为同步解决方案的运行状态。包括：success、fail

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful. 
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：

true：成功。 
false：失败
